author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a foam cloud of round bumps overhanging the mug on both sides with the largest bump at the right, a straight-walled mug with rounded base corners, and a rounded rectangular handle; matches the reference. The rejected drawing had a thin, cramped foam band and a heavy handle.
omissions: None; the handle is shortened to sit 9 units below the foam corner.
drawing_plan: Foam closed cloud over base y=20; body U x 10..31 to y=42; handle y 29..39 to x=42.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'beer': straight mug body with a side handle and a cloud of arcs for the foam.
